title: ClientError exposes reqwest::Error in public API
description: ClientError::Http(#[from] reqwest::Error) and ClientError::WebSocket(#[from] tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::Error) embed third-party error types directly in the public enum variants. Callers who inspect these variants are now semver-locked to the same reqwest and tokio-tungstenite versions as this crate. A major-version bump of either dep would be a breaking API change. Idiomatic approach: box the inner error as a dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync, or use an opaque newtype. Compare: the jmap-types JmapError does not expose any third-party types in its public interface.
